name: The Legend of Stalvan
label: Quest
description: In Goldshire, the search for Stalvan Mistmantle turns to an old letter left at the inn. Its trail leads from Elwynn Forest to Stormwind's Canal District.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Goldshire, the search for Stalvan Mistmantle turns to an old letter left at the inn. Its trail leads from Elwynn Forest to Stormwind's Canal District.

At the Lion's Pride Inn, Innkeeper Farley remembers a stormy night from years ago. A traveling courier came in from the pouring rain to find shelter, then rushed downstairs around midnight in a panic. He wore only his sleepwear as he fled into the dark storm. No one saw him again.

The courier left his satchel and personal chest in the upstairs room when he fled. Among the forgotten cargo was an unsent letter bearing the name Stalvan, addressed to someone in Stormwind City's Canal District. The chest sat untouched at the foot of the bed until Farley allowed it to be opened.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The name Stalvan rings a bell. I remember now.

Many years back, on a stormy night, a messenger came in, seeking refuge for the night. Near the stroke of midnight, the man ran down the stairs screaming, his face pale with fear. Still wearing his bedclothes, he disappeared into the downpour.
In his haste he forgot his letters in the chest upstairs. He never returned for them. One remains from that Stalvan fellow, intended for the Canal District in Stormwind. Help yourself to it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have ya got there? Let me take a look at that...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've got some nerve bringing this here.
